Quatopsy v0.1.0: Local spacecraft attitude diagnostics

Quatopsy 0.1.0 is a claim-bounded private research release of a local CLI and static viewer that diagnoses supported defects in declared quaternion attitude CSV files.

- **Diagnostics:** Closed V1 rules cover unit norm, timestamps, deterministic `S^3` lift, sign discontinuities, rates, near-pi ties, and optional commanded-path comparison.
- **Repairs:** Sign-lift and normalisation candidates are written as new files, bound to analysis digests, and never overwrite source trajectories.
- **Viewer:** `quatopsy view` emits a local static bundle. The canonical report remains the only verdict source.
- **Profile and budget:** Spacecraft CSV profile `quatopsy.spacecraft-csv/1` is frozen on synthetic fixtures, and one million samples meet the local time and RSS budget.
- **Packaging:** `scripts/package-local.sh` emits a checksummed local binary for the build host. Artefacts are not signed and are not a multi-architecture release matrix.

This release is advisory. It does not claim novelty, safety, flight approval, independent validation, production support, or a cleared trademark. The repository stays private; crates stay unpublished; hosted CI stays disabled.

Install from a clone of this private repository:

```bash
./scripts/ci-local.sh
./scripts/package-local.sh
./dist/quatopsy --version
```

See [frozen claims](https://github.com/kabudu/quatopsy/blob/v0.1.0/docs/CLAIMS.md), the [spacecraft profile](https://github.com/kabudu/quatopsy/blob/v0.1.0/docs/SPACECRAFT_PROFILE.md), and the [changelog](https://github.com/kabudu/quatopsy/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.md).
